intent: Let a user add files via drag-and-drop or a file picker, with per-file progress and a list of what's been added.
avoid_when: a single, simple file-select trigger is enough with no drop zone or progress UI (use file-upload-trigger)
a11y_contract: each in-progress file row exposes `role="progressbar"` with aria-valuenow/min/max and an aria-label naming the file ("<name> upload progress")
responsive_contract: secondary metadata/actions in the file row hide below the md breakpoint to fit narrow layouts
requires_data: accepted file types/size limits; an onUpload-style handler; the current list of files and their progress
